items.title: OpenAI Scholars 2018: Meet our Scholars
items.summary: Our first class of OpenAI Scholars is underway, and you can now follow along as this group of experienced software developers becomes machine learning practitioners.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 启动了首届学者计划，旨在帮助经验丰富的软件开发人员转型为机器学习从业者。该项目侧重于人才培养与教育，而非模型技术研发。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容属于人才培养计划，不涉及模型技术本身的核心进展。
